title: analytics: the dataset draft preview drops a dotted timeDimensions entry the live strategies refuse with INVALID_FIELD
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28258 dev (PR #28553, os-dev-report `6554100004` on #28258), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: `queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true`, measured. A dotted `timeDimensions` entry with no backing include (`account.created_at`): both live faces answer `INVALID_FIELD` / 400; the preview answers one row without the time dimension (total 180).

Business reason: a preview that silently drops the time axis shows the author a chart that will refuse after publish.

## Wanted

The preview refuses the entry as the live strategies do (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400).

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `dataset preview timeDimensions` (20 hits) and `previewDrafts dotted` (4 hits): none covers the time-dimension face. **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the dataset compiler and the draft preview path).

Links back: #28258, PR #28553, #28201 (the preview undeclared-dimension precedent, closed)
